chronology.title: Sequence of Major Indian Sovereignty Battles (1000–1700 CE)
chronology.chapter_title: Resisting Foreign Invasions and Preserving Sovereignty (1000–1700 CE)
ordered_steps: 1336 CE: Foundation of Vijayanagara Empire to resist southern invasions.
1576 CE: Battle of Haldighati and Mewar hill resistance under Maharana Pratap.
1659 CE: Battle of Pratapgad and Maratha consolidation under Shivaji Maharaj.
1671 CE: Ahom naval victory over Mughals at Battle of Saraighat.
1674 CE: Formal coronation of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj as Sovereign.
1721 CE: Defense of Vijaydurg sea fort by Kanhoji Angre against European fleets.

chronology.title: Stages of the Public Policy Cycle
chronology.chapter_title: Foundations of Governance, Public Policy, and Ethical Public Life
ordered_steps: 1. Agenda Setting: Identifying societal problems requiring government action.
2. Policy Formulation: Drafting potential policy options and consulting experts.
3. Policy Adoption: Formal approval and legal enactment by Parliament/Executive.
4. Policy Implementation: Operational execution by administrative ministries.
5. Policy Evaluation: Measuring outcomes, assessing feedback, and revising rules.
